methodology_note: Computed from PLFS 2017-18 unit-level microdata: average gross earnings during the preceding calendar month from the regular salaried/wage activity (schedule block 6 item 9, asked of persons with current weekly status 31/71/72), age 15+, rural+urban, both sexes, weighted by the official annual first-visit weight; household religion joined from the household file. The published reports never break earnings down by religion; the same estimator reproduces the published all-ages earnings tables (2021-22 to 2023-24 reports) across all 27 cells within 0.03% with exactly matching sample counts. Nominal rupees (levels reflect inflation; the comparable story is the relative gap - Muslim earnings run 16-23% below the all-India average in every round). NSO unit-data rider: religion is self-reported; no sub-state estimates. Pulled via the MoSPI NADA API; zip sha256 in sources/nada/plfs-2017-18/. Year=2017 is the start of the Jul-2017 to Jun-2018 reference period.
